name: Piston
summary: Self-hostable, high-performance engine for running untrusted code in many languages via a simple REST API.
description: Piston executes untrusted, possibly malicious code in isolation and exposes runtimes, package management and execute endpoints over HTTP (plus an interactive WebSocket endpoint when self-hosted). Language runtimes are installed as packages. Wrappers exist for Node, Python and Java. **Since 15 Feb 2026 the public emkc.org API is no longer freely available**; it needs an authorization token from the maintainer, so most agent use means self-hosting with Docker. Self-hosting defaults (api/src/config.js and docs/configuration.md): the API binds to 0.0.0.0:2000, compile and run memory limits are -1 (unlimited), and max processes per job is 64 (the readme still says 256). The API has no authentication, including the POST and DELETE /api/v2/packages endpoints that install and remove runtimes, so do not expose it publicly.

agent_access.notes: Self-hosted API has no auth by default (put it behind your own gateway). Public API requires a token from EngineerMan.
